{{Quote|You want to get the Separatists and their "Freedom droids" out of here? I have a plan&hellip; help me out, and you'll see. They'll all see!|The droid engineer|<ref name="Encounter" />}}
An individual served as a '''droid engineer''' during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encounter" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Driving the Point|Ord Mantell}}</ref> the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] sought to prove his worth to the Galactic Republic and requested assistance in assembling an improved [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]], claiming it would help drive out the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] and their so-called "Freedom droids."<ref name="Encounter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The droid engineer first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Driving the Point,"<ref name="Encounter" /> introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
